items.summary: DeepSeek has launched and open-sourced DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, an experimental large language model positioned as a step toward its next-generation model. According to TechNode, the release cuts API prices by more than 50%.

items.title: What GPT-OSS leaks about OpenAI's training data
items.raw_content: OpenAI recently released their open-weights model. Here we'll discuss how that inevitably leaks some information about their model training stack, and, on the way, show that GPT-5 was trained on phrases from adult websites....
items.title_zh: GPT-OSS 泄露了 OpenAI 训练数据的哪些信息
items.summary: An analysis argues that OpenAI's recently released open-weights model inevitably leaks details of its training stack, and claims that GPT-5 was trained on phrases from adult websites.

items.title: Jules, remote coding agent from Google Labs, announces API
items.raw_content: Weâre writing to let you know that as part of our work to unify our agentic coding efforts, Jules will wind down on December 31, 2026. You have until November 11, 2026 to continue finishing up sessions. After November 11, 2026, we will be turning Jules to read-only until the end of the year. When we launched Jules, it was an experiment to learn how asynchronous coding agents could help you tackle your backlog and ship faster. What you built with it taught us where agentic development is headed, and those learnings are shaping products across Google, including our agent-first platform, Google Antigravity.
items.title_zh: Google Labs 的远程编码智能体 Jules 宣布推出 API
items.summary: Google Labs says its Jules coding agent will wind down on December 31, 2026 as part of efforts to unify its agentic coding work, with sessions available until November 11, 2026 before the service turns read-only. The company said lessons from Jules are shaping products across Google, including its agent-first platform Google Antigravity.

items.title: The history of cataract surgery
items.title_zh: 白内障手术的历史
items.summary: An essay traces 4,000 years of cataract surgery, from crude procedures using thorn instruments to a 20-minute operation with a 95 percent clinical success rate, and notes that broadening access is the next challenge.

items.summary: Codeberg, a non-profit community-led organization that provides a home for free and open-source projects, has reached 300,000 projects.

items.summary: A developer who has spent three years building and scaling RAG systems argues that RAG-based architectures are in decline as context windows expand and agent-based architectures mature.

items.summary: Israel's war in Gaza left more than half a million Palestinians in a cycle of starvation, destitution and death, according to a UN-backed initiative; five charts explain how.

items.summary: Simon Willison writes that coding agents such as Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex CLI mark a genuine step change in how useful LLMs are for producing working code. The post examines how to design the agentic loops that drive these tools.

items.title: sindresorhus/css-extras
items.title_zh: sindresorhus/css-extras：基于 @function 规则的实用 CSS 自定义函数
items.summary: A collection of useful CSS custom functions built on the new @function rule.

items.title: Security and Privacy Analysis of Tile's Location Tracking Protocol
items.title_zh: Tile 位置追踪协议的安全与隐私分析
items.summary: Researchers present the first comprehensive security analysis of Tile, the crowd-sourced location-tracking service, identifying exploitable vulnerabilities and design flaws. They find that Tile's servers can persistently learn the location of all users and tags, that unprivileged adversaries can track users through Bluetooth advertisements, and that the anti-theft mode is easily subverted.

items.title: ATLAS: Constraints-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Real-World Travel Planning
items.title_zh: ATLAS：面向真实旅行规划的限制感知多智能体协作
items.summary: ATLAS is a multi-agent framework for constraint-aware travel planning with dynamic constraint management, iterative plan critique and adaptive search; it raised the TravelPlanner final pass rate from 23.3% to 44.4% and reached 84% in a live-search, multi-turn setting versus 59% for ReAct.

items.title: Machine Learning Algorithms for Improving Black Box Optimization Solvers
items.title_zh: 用机器学习算法改进黑盒优化求解器
items.summary: This survey reviews how machine learning and reinforcement learning are used to improve black-box optimization solvers, covering surrogate models, meta-learning portfolios, RL-based operator configuration and benchmarks such as the NeurIPS 2020 BBO Challenge and MetaBox.

items.title: A Compact, Low Power Transprecision ALU for Smart Edge Devices
items.title_zh: 面向智能边缘设备的紧凑低功耗可变精度 ALU
items.summary: The paper presents an ASIC design of a Transprecision Arithmetic and Logic Unit (TALU) that supports Posit, floating-point and integer formats at 8, 16 and 32 bits and can be reconfigured at runtime. It reports a 54.6x cut in power and a 19.8x cut in area versus a state-of-the-art unified MAC unit, and about 2x better energy efficiency on an ML kernel run on a RISC-V vector processor.

items.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Models: Perspectives and Misconceptions
items.title_zh: 分层推理模型：观点与常见误解
items.summary: The authors review the Hierarchical Reasoning Model, which introduces recurrent reasoning in the latent space of transformers and has shown strong results on a range of 2D reasoning tasks. They examine key design choices, test alternative variants and clarify common misconceptions about this line of models.

items.title: When Hallucination Costs Millions: Benchmarking AI Agents in High-Stakes Adversarial Financial Markets
items.title_zh: 当幻觉代价数百万：在高风险对抗性金融市场中评测 AI 智能体
items.summary: The authors present CAIA, a benchmark for AI agents in adversarial, high-stakes settings where misinformation is weaponized and errors are irreversible, using crypto markets as a testbed. Across 17 models and 178 time-anchored tasks, frontier models reach only 28% accuracy without tools and 67.4% with tools, against an 80% human baseline.

items.title: AttentionViG: Cross-Attention-Based Dynamic Neighbor Aggregation in Vision GNNs
items.title_zh: AttentionViG：视觉 GNN 中基于交叉注意力的动态邻居聚合
items.summary: The authors propose a cross-attention-based neighbor aggregation scheme, with queries from a node and keys from its neighbors, and an architecture called AttentionViG that reaches state-of-the-art ImageNet-1K accuracy while transferring to detection, segmentation and ADE20K tasks with comparable FLOPs.
